# gazebo-mcp — Full Corpus

## Tools

### Gazebo (simulation control)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `gz_topic_pub(topic, msg_type, message)` | Publish a message to a Gazebo simulation topic (e.g. /model/rover/cmd_vel). `msg_type` like `gz.msgs.Twist`. |
| `gz_topic_list()` | List all active Gazebo topics in the running simulation. |
| `gz_sim_state()` | List all models currently in the simulation. Returns `{models: [...], count: N}`. |
| `gz_service_call(service, req_type, rep_type, request, timeout)` | Call a Gazebo service (spawn, delete, pause, etc.). |

### Fleet bridges

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `sync_to_yahboom(robot_model, command, params?)` | Push a Gazebo robot command to the physical Yahboom robot. Commands: move, stop, patrol, scan. |
| `sync_to_unity(models?)` | Export Gazebo scene to Unity 3D visualization. Defaults to all models. |
| `sync_to_resonite(models?, position?)` | Spawn Gazebo models in Resonite VR world. Optional spawn position JSON. |
| `sync_to_freecad(model, format?)` | Export a Gazebo model to FreeCAD (step, stl, iges, fcstd). |
| `fleet_sync_all(models?)` | One-shot broadcast of Gazebo sim state to all connected fleet repos. |
| `fleet_status()` | Health check all connected fleet repos. Returns per-repo status. |

### Prefab App tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `fleet_status_app()` | Fleet health as a rich card view (Prefab UI). |
| `gz_sim_state_app()` | Gazebo model list as a rich card view (Prefab UI). |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `gazebo_help(topic?)` | Guidance for simulation control and fleet bridging. Topics: overview, fleet. |

## Environment

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `FLEET_YAHBOOM_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:10893` | yahboom-mcp backend |
| `FLEET_UNITY3D_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:10831` | unity3d-mcp backend |
| `FLEET_RESONITE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:10979` | resonite-mcp backend |
| `FLEET_FREECAD_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:10945` | freecad-mcp backend |
| `FLEET_ROBOTICS_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:10706` | robotics-mcp web dashboard |

## Run

### stdio (MCP server)
```
uv run python -m ag_gazebo_bridge.server --stdio
```

### HTTP (streamable HTTP transport)
```
uv run python -m ag_gazebo_bridge.server
```

### Tests
```
uv run pytest
```

### Lint
```
uv run ruff check src/
uv run ruff format src/
```

## Architecture

```
Gazebo Sim (gz) ──gz CLI──▶ gazebo-mcp ──REST──▶ yahboom-mcp (physical robot)
                                                  ├── unity3d-mcp (3D viz)
                                                  ├── resonite-mcp (VR)
                                                  ├── freecad-mcp (CAD export)
                                                  └── robotics-mcp (orchestration)
```

Transport: stdio (Claude Desktop) or streamable HTTP (browser/CURL).

## Fleet / related MCPs

| Repo | Port | Role |
|------|------|------|
| robotics-mcp | 10706 | Fleet orchestration |
| yahboom-mcp | 10893 | Physical Yahboom robot control |
| unity3d-mcp | 10831 | 3D visualization / render |
| resonite-mcp | 10979 | VR spatial sync |
| freecad-mcp | 10945 | CAD model import/export |

## Troubleshooting

1. **gz not found** — ensure Gazebo Garden/Harmonic is installed and `gz` is on PATH. On Windows, run via WSL2.
2. **Fleet repo down** — the target MCP server is not running. Start it or check its port.
3. **Topic publish fails** — verify the simulation is running (`gz sim`), the topic exists, and the message type matches.
4. **Timeout** — Gazebo commands time out after 15s. Large simulations may need more time.
5. **Dual transport** — omit `--stdio` to use streamable HTTP transport on the default port.
